results.text: Risk of Recurrent Hypoglycemia and Long-term Survival after total Pancreatectomy: A Prospective Observational Study. To evaluate risk of severe hypoglycemia after total pancreatectomy (TP). Historically, TP was feared due to loss of insulin and counter-regulatory hormones, as well as the risk of severe hypoglycemic events (SHE). Insulinoma Mimic: Tramadol-induced Hypoglycemia. Endogenous hyperinsulinemia hypoglycemia has numerous etiologies. The objective of this report is to describe a patient with severe hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia with no known history of diabetes or hypoglycemia who presented with acute altered mental status. Blood glucose was noted to be 40 mg/dL (2.22 mmol/L) (reference range 65-125 mg/dL; 3.61-6.94 mmol/L). The patient's sulfonylurea screen was negative.
